+def _default_project(scopes: frozenset) -> str:
+    """Self-service tokens are issued read:{uid}/write:{uid}; an unqualified
+    recall/ingest (no project argument) resolves to that owner project.
+    Returns '' for admin/legacy wildcard scopes (no single owner project)."""
+    for s in scopes:
+        if s.startswith("read:") and s != "read:*":
+            return s[len("read:"):]
+    for s in scopes:
+        if s.startswith("write:") and s != "write:*":
+            return s[len("write:"):]
+    return ""
+
+
